caption: The drawing contains two separate decorative elements. The top element is a semi-circular, fan-shaped composition with a central human figure who has blue wings, brown hair and beard, purple robe, red mantle, and a halo outlined in black. This figure is positioned as if reclining or floating among stylized, wavy forms in green, blue, and red. On each side of the figure, there is a potted plant with feathery, palm-like red and brown leaves emerging from a textured brown pot, outlined in black. The background is a dull yellowish-tan, bordered by scalloped, wavy bands in shades of green, red, and blue. Below this, a decorative horizontal band has a straight, rectangular shape with a scalloped red border on top and a green, wave-like band below, all outlined in black; this band repeats the colors and motifs of the upper element but contains no figures or plants. The entire composition is drawn on a plain cream-colored, slightly yellowed background.
title: Lunette and Detail from Altar Church at Sanctuario, Chimayo
